segments.sn22.123:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ āyasmā ca sāriputto āyasmā ca mahākoṭṭhiko bārāṇasiyaṃ viharanti isipatane migadāye.
segments.sn22.123:1.2: Atha kho āyasmā mahākoṭṭhiko sāyanhasamayaṃ paṭisallānā vuṭṭhito yenāyasmā sāriputto tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā … pe … etadavoca –
segments.sn22.123:2.1: “Sutavatāvuso sāriputta, bhikkhunā katame dhammā yoniso manasi kātabbā”ti?
segments.sn22.123:2.2: “Sutavatāvuso koṭṭhika, bhikkhunā pañcupādānakkhandhā aniccato … pe … anattato yoniso manasi kātabbā.
segments.sn22.123:2.5: Sutavatāvuso koṭṭhika, bhikkhunā ime pañcupādānakkhandhā aniccato … pe … anattato yoniso manasi kātabbā.
segments.sn22.123:2.6: Ṭhānaṃ kho panetaṃ, āvuso, vijjati – yaṃ sutavā bhikkhu ime pañcupādānakkhandhe aniccato … pe … anattato yoniso manasi karonto sotāpattiphalaṃ sacchikareyyā”ti.
segments.sn22.123:3.1: “Sotāpannena panāvuso sāriputta, bhikkhunā katame dhammā yoniso manasi kātabbā”ti?
segments.sn22.123:3.2: “Sotāpannenapi kho āvuso koṭṭhika, bhikkhunā ime pañcupādānakkhandhā aniccato … pe … anattato yoniso manasi kātabbā.
segments.sn22.123:3.3: Ṭhānaṃ kho panetaṃ, āvuso, vijjati – yaṃ sotāpanno bhikkhu ime pañcupādānakkhandhe aniccato … pe … anattato yoniso manasi karonto sakadāgāmiphalaṃ … pe … anāgāmiphalaṃ … pe … arahattaphalaṃ sacchikareyyā”ti.
segments.sn22.123:4.1: “Arahatā panāvuso sāriputta, katame dhammā yoniso manasi kātabbā”ti?
segments.sn22.123:4.2: “Arahatāpi khvāvuso, koṭṭhika, ime pañcupādānakkhandhā aniccato dukkhato rogato gaṇḍato sallato aghato ābādhato parato palokato suññato anattato yoniso manasi kātabbā.
segments.sn22.123:4.3: Natthi, khvāvuso, arahato uttari karaṇīyaṃ, katassa vā paticayo;
segments.sn22.123:4.4: api ca kho ime dhammā bhāvitā bahulīkatā diṭṭhadhammasukhavihārāya ceva saṃvattanti satisampajaññā cā”ti.

lines: Dasamasmiñhi “sīlavatā”ti catupārisuddhisīlaṃ vuttaṃ, idha sutavatāti kammaṭṭhānasutaṃ idameva nānākaraṇaṃ.
Kammaṭṭhānassa uggahadhāraṇaparicayamanasikāravasena pavattañāṇaṃ kammaṭṭhānasutavasena nipphajjanato “sutan”ti vuttaṃ.
